confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader output, fallback text search, rendered methods pages, and a supplement/source-route check were reviewed. The moving-sound trajectory, apparatus, speed, duration, gain calibration, TMS trigger positions, tactile probe structure, ITI, repetitions, blocks, and baseline strategy are reported. Remaining gaps are the exact sound waveform/source asset, exact speaker-volume algorithm, tactile pulse duration/current, and numeric response timeout.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The auditory trajectory and trial schedule can be recreated, but the scientific endpoint is TMS/MEP modulation rather than a normal behavioral tactile-detection PPS profile. A toolkit emulation would need a moving-sound plus rare-tactile attention schedule, while TMS/EMG would remain external instrumentation.

source_checks.scope: PDF pages 2-5 for Method, Figure 1, auditory apparatus, tactile probes, TMS timing, trial counts, baselines, and results sanity checks.
Used as primary extracted text map and checked against rendered PDF pages and targeted text searches.
Targeted searches for sound, loudspeaker, IN/OUT, distance, TMS, tactile, baseline, catch, response, block, trial, ITI, and repetition terms.
Visual methods-page check; temporary rendered page images were not committed.
Tracked ledger and web/source search did not identify a downloadable supplement for this article.

review_attempts.result: Mapped candidate Segment 1-4 values across 17 of 25 fields.
Confirmed the eight-loudspeaker array, 105 cm path, 3 s sound duration, 35 cm/s speed, IN/OUT directions, 70 dB near-hand calibration, and six sampled positions.
Separated TMS moving-sound trials from rare tactile no-TMS attention trials, PRE/POST MEP baselines, and the post-experiment localization control.
Confirmed TMS pulses 50 ms after the sound reached each sampled position, rare tactile probes on the right hand, PRE/POST no-noise baselines, and tactile-TMS separation.
Confirmed 12 TMS repetitions per direction-position cell, 144 TMS trials across 4 blocks, 24 tactile no-TMS trials randomly intermingled, and 10-12 s ITI.
Rendered pages 2-5 were inspected to verify the methods text, Figure 1 geometry, and trial-count paragraph.
No supplement was found in the tracked ledger or web/source route check; missing waveform and tactile-calibration details remain main-PDF gaps.

stimulus_type.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-5, Method/Figure 1; supplement route checked 2026-06-16
stimulus_type.evidence_note: The paper reports moving sounds but does not identify the waveform as noise, tone, or another sound class.

source_provenance.value: Custom Matlab software and a microcontroller controlled an eight-speaker array; exact source sound file or waveform asset is not supplied.
source_provenance.evidence_note: Apparatus/software provenance is reported, while the audio asset is not.

trajectory_count.value: Two moving-sound directions: IN approaching the body/hand and OUT receding from it.
trajectory_count.evidence_note: The hypotheses and Figure 1 explicitly distinguish IN and OUT sounds.

trajectory_path.value: Sound moved along an eight-loudspeaker line beside the right hand, with loudspeakers 15 cm apart and sampled positions at 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, and 90 cm from the hand over a 105 cm device span.
trajectory_path.page_or_section: PDF pp.3-4, Figure 1 and Main experiment
trajectory_path.evidence_note: Figure and methods give the speaker array and sampled distance positions.

stimulus_duration.value: The moving sound traversed the 105 cm path in 3 s.
stimulus_duration.evidence_note: Duration is explicitly reported with path length and speed.

auditory_conditions.value: Experimental factors were sound movement direction (IN, OUT) and sound position/distance (15, 30, 45, 60, 75, 90 cm). Sounds were task-irrelevant during TMS trials.
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: The design paragraph gives the 2 x 6 direction-distance factor structure.

gain_envelope.value: A microcontroller controlled volume flow across speakers; maximum intensity was calibrated by phonometer to 70 dB at the closest hand position for both IN and OUT sounds.
gain_envelope.evidence_note: Calibration and cross-speaker volume control are reported; exact gain algorithm is not.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Custom-made eight-loudspeaker array hidden from view, Matlab control, microcontroller volume flow, CED interface triggering TMS, phonometer calibration.
renderer_or_apparatus.page_or_section: PDF p.3, Figure 1 and Main experiment
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: The auditory rendering apparatus is described in the main experiment section.

trial_rows_families.value: Rows/families: PRE baseline MEP recording, EXP TMS moving-sound trials, EXP rare tactile no-TMS trials, POST baseline MEP recording, and a later sound-localization control task.
trial_rows_families.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-4, Main experiment and localization judgments
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: The methods separate baseline, experimental, tactile-probe, and localization phases.

condition_intermixing.value: Within EXP, TMS trials from the 2 x 6 direction-distance design were randomly combined and randomly intermingled with rare tactile no-TMS trials.
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: The design paragraph reports random combination and intermingling.

blocked_or_random_order.value: The sequence was PRE baseline, EXP session, POST baseline; the 144 TMS trials were equally distributed across four experimental blocks and randomized within the design.
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: Baseline order and four EXP blocks are explicitly reported.

iti_jitter_policy.value: Software-controlled inter-trial interval was always greater than 10 s, precisely 10-12 s; tactile stimuli were at least 4-5 s apart from TMS pulses.
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: The ITI range and tactile-TMS separation are both reported.

response_window.evidence_note: Participants responded verbally as fast as possible to rare tactile probes, but no numeric response deadline/window was found.

task_sequence_rules.value: Subjects ignored task-irrelevant sounds during TMS trials, kept the hand relaxed, and responded verbally only to rare tactile stimulation on the dorsum of the right hand.
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: The TMS/ignore-sound and tactile-response rules are reported.

tactile_stimulus.value: Rare tactile stimulation used a DS7A Digitimer constant-current electrical stimulator via Neuroline neurological electrodes on the dorsum of the right hand.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Stimulator, electrode type, and body site are reported; pulse duration/current are not.

soa_table.value: Sampled sound positions were 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, and 90 cm from the hand; TMS was delivered 50 ms after the sound reached a sampled position, and tactile probes used the same six positions without TMS.
soa_table.page_or_section: PDF pp.3-4, Main experiment and localization control
soa_table.evidence_note: The event table is reported as distance-at-event rather than a normal behavioral SOA ladder.

baseline_strategy.value: MEP baseline used PRE and POST no-noise baseline recordings with subjects' eyes closed; averaged baseline MEPs were used to compute MEP modulation.
baseline_strategy.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-4, Main experiment and Data pre-processing
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: Baseline blocks and baseline-normalized MEP index are described.

baseline_timing.value: Baseline was phase-level rather than in-trial: one PRE and one POST block were run without sound/noise around the EXP session.
baseline_timing.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-4, Main experiment and Data pre-processing
baseline_timing.evidence_note: No baseline SOA exists; baselines are pre/post recording phases.

catch_trial_type.value: No conventional catch label is used. The 144 TMS moving-sound trials are tactile-absent/no-response trials while subjects wait for rare tactile probes; false alarms to tactile were tracked.
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: Derived from rare tactile target instructions, target-absent TMS trials, and reported false alarms.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: TMS trials: each of the 12 direction-position cells was repeated 12 times. Rare tactile no-TMS trials: 2 repetitions per direction-position cell, 24 total. Localization control: 6 per cell, 72 total.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.page_or_section: PDF p.4, Main experiment and localization judgments
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: Repetition counts are explicit for TMS, tactile no-TMS, and localization-control trials.

baseline_count.value: Two baseline blocks, PRE and POST, each had 12 baseline MEP trials; each baseline also included 2 tactile attention probes without TMS.
baseline_count.evidence_note: Baseline block and tactile-probe counts are reported.

catch_count.value: If tactile-absent no-response trials are treated as catch trials, EXP contains 144 target-absent TMS moving-sound trials; the paper does not use the term catch.
catch_count.evidence_note: Derived from 144 TMS trials without tactile targets and rare tactile-response instructions.

block_count.value: Three main phases were run: PRE baseline, EXP, and POST baseline. EXP TMS trials were equally distributed across four experimental blocks.
block_count.evidence_note: Phase and EXP block counts are explicitly reported.

total_trial_count.value: Main experiment contains 144 TMS trials plus 24 EXP tactile no-TMS trials and 24 baseline MEP trials; baseline tactile probes add or are included as 2 per baseline, so total is about 192-196 depending on inclusion.
total_trial_count.evidence_note: Derived from explicit counts; wording is ambiguous about whether baseline tactile probes are included in the 12 baseline trials.

critical_caveats: The paper does not report the exact sound waveform class, source file, noise seed, or frequency content.
The cross-speaker volume-flow algorithm is described only qualitatively, not as a reproducible gain table.
Tactile pulse duration and current/intensity calibration are not reported in the main PDF.
No numeric response deadline/window is reported for the rare tactile verbal responses.
This is a TMS/MEP motor-system design, not a standard behavioral tactile-reaction-time PPS profile.
The baseline tactile-probe count is reported, but it is ambiguous whether those probes are included in or additional to the 12 baseline MEP trials.
next_manual_action: This paper is strong enough for a moving-sound/TMS-profile metadata template, but a behavioral toolkit emulation should label TMS/EMG as external instrumentation and approximate the unspecified waveform, exact gain algorithm, tactile pulse parameters, and response window.
